subject: Application for Software & AI Engineering Intern 29 - Monish Gowda M
body:
Dear TechCorp-29 Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my enthusiastic interest in the Software & AI Engineering Intern 29 position. As a 3rd-year B.Tech student in AI/ML with a CGPA of 8.7, my background in autonomous edge telemetry pipelines and state verification directly aligns with your requirements.

In my recent project 'Autonomous Edge Telemetry & Vision Pipeline', I reduced inference latency by 34% using PyTorch and FastAPI. I look forward to contributing to TechCorp-29.

Sincerely,
Monish Gowda M
